children: Medibank Private's newest bull touts the potential gains from having more clinics. Jefferies estimates Medibank's primary care business will generate an operating profit of 52 million Australian dollars in FY27. Analyst Vanessa Thomson says this profit contribution will grow if Medibank increases clinics, raises consultations per clinic or lifts profit per consultation. If Medibank increases clinics by 3% annually over the next 3 years, then FY29 primary care operating profit would increase by 8% and add A$6 million to group operating profit. "This would also increase Medibank's share of Medicare GP consultations to circa 3.6% with a corresponding increase in their sphere of influence," Jefferies says. It upgrades Medibank to buy from hold and raises its price target by 12% to A$5.80/share. Medibank is up 0.4% at A$5.01. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
